notes: The era is assumed to be Vikrama because it is written as 'saṃvat' and the copy was made at Kāśī. 'mustāvāda' comes right after the scribe's name. It may be his home town or part of the place of copying, perhaps Mustafabad. 'kāsiṃraṃdhanagara' is corrupt. The catalogue reads it as 'raṃdhanagara samīpa' near Kāśī. It might mean Rāmnagar opposite Vārāṇasī, but that is uncertain. 'liṣataṃ' stands for likhitaṃ. The catalogue's 'Manasārāmasvāmī' is read here as Manasārāma with the title svāmin.
